hypotheses.synthesis: Adaptive dependency-aware routing cannot be scientifically adjudicated from repository outcomes unless the pre-route dependency projection, route decision, causal predecessor state and receiver closure are persisted per delta.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Retrospective repository reconstruction is sufficient to recover all routing inputs and outcomes without new instrumentation.
hypotheses.falsifier: Reconstruct the 15:56 event deterministically from durable repo state and reproduce candidate route decisions, receiver closure and resource costs without hidden or unstored state.
hypotheses.highest_information_experiment: Instrument one exact-current fusion delta end to end, then replay it under broadcast, tag-only and adaptive routing with matched inputs and faults.

hypotheses.synthesis: Route strategy should remain adaptive among targeted, dense and digest/full-recompute modes because change locality and cost vary by workload.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: A fixed targeted policy with anti-entropy is simpler and Pareto-dominant for Clay workloads.
hypotheses.falsifier: Matched real-repo replay shows fixed-targeted has equal or better recall, latency, resource cost and recovery across sparse and dense invalidations.
hypotheses.highest_information_experiment: Stratified sparse/local versus high-centrality/global invalidation replay with exact cost shadows.

hypotheses.synthesis: A bounded approximate priority shadow may reduce routing and triage cost without weakening exact research-state truth if authority is typed and fail-closed.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Approximate priority inevitably leaks into canonical mutation through scheduling and suppresses important evidence.
hypotheses.falsifier: Shadow lesion or perturbation changes canonical truth/effect decisions beyond explicitly permitted scheduling order, or misses high-impact invalidations.
hypotheses.highest_information_experiment: Exact-vs-shadow authority-boundary differential with contradictory and high-centrality events.

hypotheses.synthesis: WP03 residual semantic identity preservation is necessary but not sufficient; WP04/WP05 require an explicit disposition matrix so preserved rule/invariant classes do not become stranded meaning.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Residual classes are purely preservation metadata and need no downstream semantic disposition.
hypotheses.falsifier: Per-class mutation and no-drop tests show no behavioral, validation, authority or recovery consequence for every residual class.
hypotheses.highest_information_experiment: WP04/WP05 per-class disposition matrix prioritizing rule_decl and invariant_decl.
